# Previously funded projects

We are so proud to have sponsored two projects so far:

::::: image-grid
::: image-card
<img src="images/Madagascar farms/03 Dried BSF larvae at a small farm (Nov 2024).jpg"/>

<h2>Black Soldier Fly microfarms in Madagascar</h2>

<p>This project developed research, guides and training for local farmers to use soldier fly farming (BSF) as a simple and low-cost way to turn waste and invasive plants into valuable resources like animal feed, organic fertilizer and nutritious food.</p>

<p>**Project leader:** Dr Brian Fisher</p>

<p>**Project website:** [Madagascar Bio](https://www.madagascarbio.org/bsf-farms.html)</p>
:::

::: image-card
<img src="images/croc/adult gharial holding.png"/>

<h2>Gharial conservation in Nepal</h2>

<p>The Himalayan Gharial Project is a conservation and research initiative dedicated to understanding why the gharials remain Critically Endangered in Nepal, and how to support their long-term recovery.</p>

<p>**Project leader:** Dr Phoebe Griffith</p>

<p>**Project website:** [Himalayan Nature](https://www.himalayannature.org/works/projects/himalayan-gharial-project/)</p>
:::
